value.rationale: The source identifies mutually amplifying prey and predator recruitment and proposes two separate saturations. Establishing a single-side sufficient repair without restricting maturation time or coupling strengths has a meaningful mechanistic interpretation and a global analytic conclusion for an infinite-dimensional renewal population. Cohort survival enforces adult predation sufficient for dissipativity. It is not a small numerical refinement or a direct scalar logistic exercise.
